pool.b.verhandlung_praemien_gruss: Good day, this is the agent for {name}, thank you for your time.
Good day, I am calling on behalf of my client {name} to raise the subject of bonuses.
pool.b.verhandlung_praemien_lage: {name} wants a bigger share of his pay tied to performance, and I have concrete ideas for it.
For {name} we need a bonus model that makes his performance count.
pool.b.verhandlung_praemien_lage.hitzig: {name} is fuming because his goals and appearances have never been worth a cent in his contract!
My client is furious that he sees nothing extra for goals and games!
pool.b.verhandlung_praemien_lage.loyal: {name} wants to meet the club halfway and will gladly carry more risk as long as it is shared fairly.
He would give up part of his fixed pay for the club if the bonuses are right.
pool.b.verhandlung_praemien_lage.ehrgeiz: {name} wants to be judged on goals and trophies and demands a proper share for them.
My client believes in his numbers and wants to earn from them.
pool.b.verhandlung_praemien_lage.wechsel: {name} is comparing bonuses elsewhere and counting every cent.
My client has offers with hefty success bonuses on the table.
pool.b.verhandlung_praemien_lage.sensibe: {name} worries about a sudden money drop during a bad patch and wants a cushion.
He is afraid of being punished for one weak month and wants a safe framework.
pool.b.verhandlung_handgeld_gruss: Good day, I am writing to you on behalf of {name}.
Good day, enclosed is the position of my client {name} on the signing.
pool.b.verhandlung_handgeld_lage: {name} expects a signing bonus for his signature, as is usual for contract extensions.
For {name}'s signature a loyalty bonus should be paid, that is market standard.
pool.b.verhandlung_handgeld_lage.hitzig: {name} gets short-tempered if he is not rewarded for signing!
My client sees no reason to sign without a bonus, and I say that unfiltered!
pool.b.verhandlung_handgeld_lage.loyal: {name} would stay even without extras, but a sign of appreciation would be fitting.
He is attached to the club, and a loyalty bonus would show that it is noticed.
pool.b.verhandlung_handgeld_lage.ehrgeiz: {name} sees a signing bonus as recognition of his market value.
My client regards himself as a key performer, and the signing bonus should reflect that.
pool.b.verhandlung_handgeld_lage.wechsel: {name} knows other clubs offer high signing bonuses and weighs that against you.
Elsewhere a decent sum awaits him for signing, I need not hide that from you.
pool.b.verhandlung_handgeld_lage.sensibe: {name} feels somewhat devalued if there is no gesture for his signature.
For him it is less about the sum than about the signal that comes with it.
pool.b.verhandlung_laufzeit_gruss: Good day, this is the agent for {name}, and it is about the contract length.
Good day, I am calling about the length of the deal for {name}.
pool.b.verhandlung_laufzeit_lage: Between us stands the question whether {name} signs short or long.
With {name} everything revolves around the contract length, and the ideas are worlds apart.
pool.b.verhandlung_laufzeit_lage.hitzig: {name} will not be forced into a long contract and gets loud when anyone tries!
My client will not be shackled, least of all for years!
pool.b.verhandlung_laufzeit_lage.loyal: {name} would gladly commit to the club for the long term if the terms are right.
He sees his future here, and the length should show that.
pool.b.verhandlung_laufzeit_lage.ehrgeiz: {name} wants to stay flexible so he is not blocked at the next step of his career.
My client fully expects to get bigger tasks soon and needs room for that.
pool.b.verhandlung_laufzeit_lage.wechsel: {name} likes short contracts because they keep every door open for him each year.
He does not want to commit, a year here, then we will see.
pool.b.verhandlung_laufzeit_lage.sensibe: {name} is looking for stability and worries about facing an uncertain future again after a year.
He needs security for planning and dreads any uncertainty at the end of a short contract.
